blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — A fire that hit an ukay-ukay (used clothes) market in General Santos City late Sunday night destroyed at least 30 stalls and about two dozen houses, causing an estimated P1.75 million in damage, the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) said. The fire broke out around 11:25 p.m. on Sunday at Purok Islam 13-A, Barangay Dadiangas South, near the General Santos City Public Market and the landmark roundball or rotunda area. Strong winds caused the flames to spread rapidly through stalls selling secondhand clothes and nearby houses. READ: Grass fire hits vicinity of General Santos airport Fire Officer 1 […]...
